title: Hegseth proposes 'ambitious' US-ASEAN defence framework at Philippine summit
paragraphs: Hegseth proposes 'ambitious' US-ASEAN defence framework at Philippine summit
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth urged the formation of a new US-ASEAN defence cooperation framework and for strengthened maritime awareness and advanced naval coordination in the region.

CEBU: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth proposed the creation of an "ambitious" new US-ASEAN defence framework on Wednesday (Oct 28), telling the bloc's leaders it could help them navigate "critically important" years ahead.
